notes.title: Beta 0.70: Raiders, GOAP AI, 3D Printing & Visual Upgrades
notes.content:
Survivors, get ready to face cunning Raiders, craft with 3D Printers, and experience upgraded visuals, and Survivor NPCs are on the way :D

[b]Update Summary[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Human Enemies - Raiders.
[*] Completed the GOAP AI framework.
[*] Unlocked large map options.
[*] Unlocked 3D Printing skill tree.
[*] Added constructible Battery Charging Station.
[*] Added constructible 3D Printer.
[*] Batteries can now be recharged.
[*] Added magnified scope effect when aiming.
[*] New location: Train Station Raider Camp.
[*] Upgraded zombie limb destruction effects.
[*] Added airflow and sonic wave visual effects.
[*] Lone Raiders may appear inside buildings.
[*] Rooms now spawn miscellaneous clutter on the floor.
[*] New items: Ammo crates, suitcases, clothing, accessories, and more.
[*] Added human corpse texture generation.
[*] Fixed issues with zombie sound effects.
[*] Fixed display errors for wire connections.
[*] Optimized character clothing layer rendering.
[*] Optimized character skin tone settings.
[*] Optimized character models and animations.
[*] Bug fixes, performance optimizations, and other improvements.
[/list]

[b]Human Enemies - Raiders[/b]

A small number of Raiders will randomly spawn across the map.
The new Train Station location will spawn a Raider camp.
Raiders can use all weapons available to players, including firearms, crossbows, bows, and melee weapons.
When forming squads, Raiders will perform tactical maneuvers such as flanking, throwing grenades, and suppressive fire.

[b]GOAP AI[/b]

Implemented human AI using the GOAP framework.
Actions are selected through decision trees.
The enemies in the classic FPS game “F.E.A.R.” were also created using the GOAP framework.
Compared to state machines, this more complex decision-making system delivers a more engaging gameplay experience.
Friendly or neutral human NPCs will be updated soon.

[b]Visual Upgrades[/b]

High-magnification scopes now feature a zoom effect, enlarging the targeted area.
Bullets now have more realistic airflow effects.
Explosions and alarms emit shockwave effects.
Zombie limb destruction effects are now more realistic and precise.

[b]Scope Aiming[/b], simulated lens distortion and chromatic aberration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40676593/8f970e5ae70888c772a6cc82a567a037b0519f0d.gif[/img]

[b]3D Printing and Battery Charging[/b]

Added two new constructible items.
The Charging Station can recharge batteries.
The 3D Printer can craft various items. (More printable weapons and items will be added in future updates.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40676593/feabe11c5562f28db7432f54653ff0c6113d8f63.gif[/img]

[b]About Async Multiplayer[/b]

In future updates, players will be able to upload their current characters to the server.
These characters will appear in other players' games.

[b]Controller Support[/b]

The game now fully supports game controllers.
Interactive key prompts are also supported.
When playing with a controller, you can press the pause button to view the key layout.

Quick function keys have been created for the controller.
Pressing the 'LB' button during gameplay will bring up the quick function wheel.
Driving, PDA, map, and other functions have also been adapted for the controller.
Some UI screens use controller to simulate mouse operations.

To support controller operations,
most of the game's Input system has been rewritten.
The new Input system also supports [b]keyboard [/b]key mapping. 
This will be available in future updates.
If you encounter any issues caused by this during gameplay,
please feel free to provide feedback through email.
These issues will be prioritized for fixing!

[i]Note: XBOX controllers and generic controllers are fully supported.
PlayStation controllers can also operate normally, but the key display has not been adapted yet, which will be addressed in future updates.[/i]

[b]SteamDeck Support[/b]

The game is now finally playable on SteamDeck!
Tests were conducted using a third-party handheld device,
and it runs perfectly.
Playing on the handheld is a very fresh experience,
so if you happen to have a handheld device,
be sure to take the time to try it out :)

Each weapon with attributes has unique properties.

The game has also introduced password boxes and locked weapons. 
Password locks require entering a code to open. 
You can try to unlock the password through trial and error, or simply craft a "decoder". 
The decoder can calculate the correct password directly using chips and sensors, 
but it will also consume batteries.

In future versions after the update, 
some newly discovered weapons may have [b]trigger lock[/b]. 
This means you cannot use them directly. 
However, this isn't necessarily a bad thing, 
because after cracking the password lock, 
weapons with trigger locks have [b]a higher chance[/b] of having [b]multiple additional weapon affixes[/b].

notes.content:
[b]Update Details[/b]:

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed lag and crashes when saving large maps[/b].
[*] Added support for [b]asynchronous game data saving[/b].
[*] Fixed a severe bug causing saved games to disappear and preventing new saves.
[*] Resolved issues with DirectX12 not launching.

Regarding the save-related problems reported by players, I've investigated and summarized the issues. Most of the problems were caused by game crashes during the save process. Due to the large data size of the world map, concurrent I/O operations during continuous saves could lead to lag and crashes. Changing the save process to asynchronous I/O effectively eliminates the lag during saving. Now you can confidently press 'F5' to save your game on the large map.

The issue of saves disappearing or preventing game creation also stemmed from individual save file errors. Most of these problems are fixable, and I've made the necessary adjustments.
Yesterday, some players sent error save files to my email, which helped me pinpoint the problematic code. Thanks! It helped a lot.


Concerning problems with the game not starting, I've done some investigation. It seems to be related to incomplete support for graphics APIs. If you continue to experience issues after updating, please feel free to provide feedback to my email.


If you encounter save-related problems, sending the error report of your save files to my email would greatly assist in identifying and fixing issues. Thank you!

helping the game maintain a relatively high frequency of updates.
Once again, we appreciate your understanding and support!

After three months of updates,
we have fixed some important bugs that affected performance and gameplay experience,
and we have also made certain optimizations to the gameplay and frame rate.
Currently, the game has finally reached a relatively stable version.

The main focus now is on the major update!
The main content of the [b]next major version[/b] includes:
[list]
[*] Farming system

[*] Second island
[*] Optimization of road generation
[*] Optimization of building generation
[*] Rail transportation system

notes.content:
ZED ZONE of Separation Early Access Phase 1 Update Plan and Beta 0.62_V4.1 Update

We would like to thank everyone for their support and tolerance since the release of Early Access.
With your support, we have a clearer update plan for the game.
Some of the artwork will be handed over to a more professional artist (I used to do it all myself...) This will help me to fill out the content more efficiently, and will also improve the artwork a bit.

[h1][b]Phase 1 Update Thread : Sailing[/b][/h1]

[b]Refinement of the game loop[/b]
[olist][*] Evacuation of the island by boat, arrival at the new map 
  [*] New ecological communities (desert/snow)
  [*] Explore more special places and special events
  [*] More weather. (heavy snow)
  [*] Optimisation of terrain generation rules.
[/olist]
[b]Farming and fishing[/b]
Planting is a feature that has a lot of scope for expansion. It also needs to be complemented by additional support systems to create the best possible play experience. In the first phase, we will be installing basic farming and fishing, and we will be refining them over time.
  [olist][*] Basic farming.
  [*] New camp NPC, farming merchant.
  [*] Fishing system.
[/olist]
[b]Optimization of the building creation site[/b].
  [olist][*] Multi-storey buildings implemented.
  [*] Generation and exploration of underground buildings.
  [*] Numerous new building types added.
[/olist]
[b]Combat system updates[/b]
  [olist] [*] Addition of more calibres of ammunition. Such as .50 BMG and .308 Lapua
  [*] A large number of new firearms have been added. Such as the Barrett heavy sniper rifle, the old smooth-bore rifle etc.
  [*] Adding melee weapons with different attack styles.
  [*] Added spears, javelins, gloves and other melee weapons.
  [*] Special attacks such as the melee weapon's power-up attack have been added. [/olist]

[b]More special infected[/b]
  [olist][*] Generate unique looking and equipped zombies based on location.
  [*] Special infected that use weapons.
[/olist]
[b]Railroading and proficiency[/b]
  [olist][*] Addition of proficiency-related skill system
  [*] Addition of a rail system
[/olist]

[h3][b]Once Phase 1 is complete, the game will continue to be updated and optimised, with key features including:[/b][/h3]
[b]Skill tree and technology tree improvements
Build system refinements and optimizations
Human enemies and AI survivors
Creative workshop support[/b]
  [olist][*] Weapon editor
  [*] Item editor
  [*] Necro Editor
  [*] Building editor
  [*] Terrain creation tool
  [*] If possible, an interface for mod authors[/olist]
[b]More game modes[/b]
  [olist][*] Online mode
  [*] SteamDeck and joystick controller support[/olist]
[u]The first phase of content will be updated first, and will be available to everyone as soon as possible.
Other updates will be added gradually.
Of course, other updates and changes will be made as they become available.
Thanks again for your support and feedback, I'll do my best. 
Thanks :D[/u]
